Method of Attack: Malware downloader designed to deploy second-stage payloads
Mimicking file information similar to legitimate software
Code obfuscation with small chunks and shuffled execution order
Payload delivery mechanism infecting victim with several malware strains
Camouflaging droppers as executables belonging to legitimate software using similar icons and metadata
Downloading additional malware including cryptocurrency miners, cookie stealers, Remote Access Trojans (RATs), and backdoors
Harvesting sensitive info such as credentials using RATs and data theft malware
Impacted Systems: Systems of users downloading cracked software via search engine advertising
Attack Vector: Search engine advertising lures targeting users searching for cracked software installers
Indicators of Compromise: Attacker-controlled domains hosting lists of URLs with malware payloads
Malware hashes and command-and-control infrastructure info (detailed in Bitdefender's whitepaper)
